phases.phase_goal: 明确 Maker 创建项目的目标，包括为什么创建、解决什么问题、服务什么对象、成功标准是什么。

state_change_requirement.description: P0 完成必要 Process 后必须形成 State Change Requirement。

gate_trigger_requirement: P0 proposes P0 -> P1 Phase Transition Request
PROJECT_PROFILE.md changes in a way that affects later Workflow progression
P0 proposes State Change Requirement that affects current project state

state_change_requirement.description: P1 完成必要 Process 后必须形成 State Change Requirement。

gate_trigger_requirement: P1 proposes P1 -> P2 Phase Transition Request
PROJECT_STATE.md changes in a way that affects later Workflow progression
P1 proposes State Change Requirement that affects current project state

phases.phase_goal: 形成项目解决方案设计。
process_boundary: 形成 Decision Proposal when required
output: PROJECT_DECISIONS.md for Maker confirmed important decisions

required_artifact_detail.Decision Proposal: not a universal required artifact for all P2 transitions

state_change_requirement.description: P2 完成必要 Process 后必须形成 State Change Requirement。

gate_trigger_requirement: P2 proposes P2 -> P3 Phase Transition Request
Solution Design Artifact changes in a way that affects later Workflow progression
P2 proposes State Change Requirement that affects current project state

state_change_requirement.description: P3 完成必要 Process 后必须形成 State Change Requirement。

gate_trigger_requirement: P3 proposes P3 -> P4 Phase Transition Request
PROJECT_PLAN.md changes in a way that affects later Workflow progression
P3 proposes State Change Requirement that affects current project state

process_boundary: 根据 Project Type 与已确认执行计划完成项目创建活动

state_change_requirement.description: P4 完成必要 Process 后必须形成 State Change Requirement。

gate_trigger_requirement: P4 proposes P4 -> P5 Phase Transition Request
Project Artifact changes in a way that affects later Workflow progression
P4 proposes State Change Requirement that affects current project state

phases.phase_goal: 确认项目成果是否满足目标。

state_change_requirement.description: P5 完成必要 Process 后必须形成 State Change Requirement。

gate_trigger_requirement: P5 proposes P5 -> P6 Phase Transition Request
Validation Result is produced or changes in a way that affects later Workflow progression
P5 proposes State Change Requirement that affects current project state

phases.phase_goal: 根据 Validation Result 推进下一轮优化。
process_boundary: 根据 Validation Result 调整解决方案
根据 Validation Result 调整执行计划
根据 Validation Result 修改 Artifact
required_artifact: Workflow Artifact modified in current Iteration

required_artifact_detail.P6 -> P2: Validation Result must explain the issue requiring re-entry to Solution Design.
required_artifact_detail.P6 -> P3: PROJECT_PLAN.md is the target Workflow Artifact for continued adjustment.
required_artifact_detail.P6 -> P4: Project Artifact is the target Workflow Artifact for continued adjustment.
required_artifact_detail.P6 -> P5: A Project Artifact that can re-enter Validation must exist.

state_change_requirement.description: P6 在提出 Phase Transition Request 时必须形成当前 Transition 所需的 State Change Requirement。

gate_trigger_requirement: P6 proposes P6 -> P2 Phase Transition Request
P6 proposes P6 -> P3 Phase Transition Request
P6 proposes P6 -> P4 Phase Transition Request
P6 proposes P6 -> P5 Phase Transition Request
P6 proposes changes to PROJECT_PLAN.md, Project Artifact, or other Workflow Artifact that affect later Workflow progression
P6 proposes State Change Requirement that affects current project state

invariants: Output is not equivalent to Required Artifact.
State Change Requirement is not Context Mutation.
Gate Trigger Requirement is not Gate Evaluation completion.
Runtime must not add Transition Path.
P6 may only request P2, P3, P4, or P5.
